description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'KeyHandlerException' within the 'OrangeHRM' HRM system. The class provides static methods for creating specific exception instances related to key handling errors.

classes.name: KeyHandlerException
classes.description: A custom exception class for key handling errors in the OrangeHRM system. Provides static methods to generate specific exceptions for common key-related issues.

methods.name: keyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key already exists.

methods.name: failedToCreateKey
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of KeyHandlerException indicating failure to create a key.

methods.name: keyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key file does not exist.

methods.name: keyIsNotReadable
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key is not readable.
